source_message:
Can you price this lot for the house and put together a delivered buying plan? Need it in the 94103 delivery zone by Friday, Sept 18. Splitting suppliers is fine. Brands are open where they meet what I've written. Round up to full sale packs where needed and show me the excess. The coverage amounts already include my allowance, so don't add another waste percentage.

Framing and sheet goods:
1. 200 of the 2x4x8 KD SPF studs, No. 2 — full 8-foot lengths.
2. 60 lengths of 2x6x10 KD SPF, No. 2.
3. 40 sheets of 7/16 OSB, 4x8, rated sheathing, Exposure 1.
4. 20 sheets 23/32 tongue-and-groove plywood subfloor, 4x8, Exposure 1.

Roof and weatherproofing:
5. Architectural asphalt shingles, charcoal — 600 sq ft. New roof section, no existing shingles to match; send me the color sample with the quote.
6. Synthetic roofing underlayment for that shingle roof — enough for 600 sq ft, using the product's stated installed coverage.
7. Two rolls housewrap, 9 ft x 100 ft, for the exterior walls; product needs to be sold as a water-resistive barrier.
8. Three rolls of housewrap seam tape, 2 inches x 55 yards, approved by the wrap maker for the wrap you quote.
9. Four rolls self-adhered window flashing tape, 4 inches x 75 feet; get the product information confirming it works with the quoted wrap and vinyl windows.

Insulation and wall finish:
10. R-13 fiberglass batts, 15-inch wide — enough for 600 sq ft of walls.
11. 60 sheets regular half-inch drywall, 4x8.
12. 12 sheets half-inch cement backer board, 3x5, sold for interior wall tile backing.
13. Four 4.5-gal pails premixed all-purpose drywall joint compound.
14. Two 500-ft rolls paper drywall joint tape.
15. Two 5-lb boxes of #6 x 1-1/4 coarse-thread drywall screws, black phosphate.

Plumbing and electrical rough-in:
16. Half-inch PEX for the water lines — one 100-ft coil red and one blue. Has to work with our fittings.
17. Eight 10-ft lengths of 2-inch Schedule 40 PVC DWV pipe, plain ends.
18. One 250-ft roll 12/2 NM-B copper cable with ground.
19. 20 single-gang plastic new-work electrical boxes, 22 cu in, nail-on.

Doors and windows:
20. Three primed smooth flush hollow-core interior door slabs, 30 x 80 x 1-3/8 inches, no bores or hinge mortises; we're doing that on site.
21. Two fixed white vinyl windows, actual unit size 24 x 36 inches, nail fin, double-pane clear insulated glass. Include the product performance sheet.

Interior finish:
22. 160 linear ft of primed MDF baseboard, square edge, 3-1/4 inches high x 9/16 thick. Stock lengths of 8 ft or longer are fine; show the lengths and total.
23. 200 sq ft click-lock vinyl plank flooring, 6 mm overall thickness, 20 mil wear layer, light oak look. No existing floor to match; send the finish sample.
24. 15 gallons interior wall paint, water-based, eggshell, factory white. Either 1-gal cans or 5-gal pails works.
25. Two gallons water-based interior trim enamel, semi-gloss, factory white.

Get the quotes first and flag anything essential I've missed. If changing a stated product spec opens up a worthwhile option, show me the actual product, the difference, and the price and delivery consequences before changing the plan. Same if a different delivery date materially changes the price. This is a buying recommendation; don't place orders.
scenario_notes: All products, product evidence, prices, tax treatment and business constraints are invented demo data.
Full sale packs only; source quantities already include the contractor allowance.
Facing and existing PEX fitting identity remain unresolved; a complete catalog is not a complete eligible plan.
No real purchase, code compliance, engineering suitability or manufacturer approval is implied.
